issues.title: Missing Per-Artifact Spec Files
issues.why: The module references 79 external spec files (NN-*.md) which are the 'canonical source of truth' for script logic, but these are not provided in the context. A mediocre AI cannot implement the toolchain logic (e.g., the specific regex for a validator or the logic for a generator) without these files.
issues.fix: Provide the content of the 50+ NN-*.md files or consolidate core logic for critical scripts into the overview.

issues.title: Delegated Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-T-29 explicitly delegates per-script logic to external files. While the 'Slot Delegation Map' and 'AC Family Prefix Index' provide metadata, they do not provide the actual Given/When/Then criteria required for implementation.
issues.fix: Include the GWT criteria for the most critical toolchain scripts (01, 05, 10, 14, 24, 70) directly in §97.

issues.title: Unresolved External Memory References
issues.why: The spec frequently references 'mem://' URIs (e.g., mem://index.md, mem://process/phase-153-lessons) and specific Phase 107/108 ledgers that are not present in the provided context.
issues.fix: Inline the specific rules or constants referenced from the memory/ledger files into the Normative Contract section.
